observations.valueText: SEC-filed prior Phase 2b CORAL readout: 24-hour cough-frequency relative change at Week 6 was -60.2% for nalbuphine ER 108 mg twice daily versus -16.9% with placebo (43.3 percentage-point placebo-adjusted difference, as reported).
observations.limitation: Separate earlier Phase 2b trial; sponsor disclosed outcome. Not the OCEAN-1 Phase 3 result. Endpoints, population, study duration, multiplicity, and statistical uncertainty must be reviewed before any RAAS grade.

observations.valueText: Company reported overall FDA End-of-Phase-2 meeting alignment on the planned Phase 3 development program for IPF-related chronic cough.
observations.limitation: Issuer characterization of FDA meeting, not an FDA-approved drug or independent review of every pivotal design and statistical detail.

observations.valueText: Trevi said the first of two IPF-related chronic cough pivotal trials, OCEAN-1, began in Q2 2026. Registered Phase 3 program NCT07671911 tests investigational oral nalbuphine ER with a double-blind placebo-controlled design.
observations.limitation: Trial start and design establish prospectively observable development status only; no OCEAN-1 Phase 3 topline evidence was available at the November 2026 capture.

observations.valueText: Trevi expected the 52-week OCEAN-1 Phase 3 topline results in the first half of 2028. OCEAN-2's separately projected second-half 2027 results are NOT an OCEAN-1 readout.
observations.limitation: Management timing estimate, not a fixed data-release date, exchange trading exit, FDA decision, or assurance results will be released when forecast.

observations.valueText: At June 30, 2026 the company reported $318.9 million in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities; the reported April 2026 offering net proceeds were approximately $162.3 million.
